summary: Second component, first built entirely through the add-component skill. Single-line text field composing label, control, helper and error as one accessible unit: label is a required prop (a placeholder is not a label), errorText derives aria-invalid and joins aria-describedby error-first, ids come from useId so instances never collide. Three sizes 48/40/32, all clearing the 24px target floor. Leading/trailing slots; the trailing action carries its own accessible name. Needed NO new tokens — the contract covered every role, which is the first evidence it has stabilised. Six design bugs were pushed back into Paper rather than transcribed (see the design-fixes entry). Hover is DERIVED from Button's secondary variant, not drawn — recorded as a known gap in the doc.

migration.manual: New item. `npx shadcn add @bydiorama/input`; pulls in the `cn` lib item, expects react and griddy-icons as peers.
